payload.description: Project task management — tracks projects, tasks, events, and customers

models.name: fct_task_event
models.description: Records every task event across all projects and tasks

columns.name: event_id
columns.description: Event id from the source system — a degenerate dimension, and this fact's own key

columns.name: task_key
columns.description: FK to dim_task

columns.name: project_key
columns.description: FK to dim_project

columns.name: customer_key
columns.description: FK to dim_customer

columns.name: event_date
columns.description: Date the event occurred

columns.name: event_type
columns.description: Type of task event (started, completed, blocked)

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Cost or value of the event

columns.name: duration_hours
columns.description: Hours spent on this event

rationale.purpose: Central fact table tracking all task activity for reporting and analysis
rationale.design: Transaction grain with surrogate foreign keys to all relevant dimensions

models.name: dim_task
models.description: Task dimension tracking individual project tasks

columns.name: task_key
columns.description: Surrogate key — one per row, so one per version of the task

columns.name: task_id
columns.description: Business key — repeats across the versions of one task

columns.name: project_key
columns.description: FK to dim_project

columns.name: name
columns.description: Task name

columns.name: status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status

rationale.purpose: Tracks individual tasks and their lifecycle
rationale.design: SCD Type 2 on status to track historical state changes
rationale.scdStrategy: task_key is unique per row; task_id repeats across the versions of one task, which is why it cannot be the primary key

columns.name: project_key
columns.description: Surrogate key — warehouse-generated, one per row

columns.name: project_code
columns.description: Business project code from the source system

columns.name: project_name
columns.description: Project name — not unique, so never a key

columns.name: parent_project_key
columns.description: Parent project for hierarchical rollups (self-reference to project_key)

rationale.purpose: Central project reference shared across domains
rationale.design: Conformed dimension for consistent project attributes
rationale.scdStrategy: project_key is the surrogate facts join to; project_code is the business key

models.name: dim_customer
models.description: Customer dimension with demographics and segmentation

columns.name: customer_key
columns.description: Surrogate key — warehouse-generated, one per row

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Business key from the source CRM

columns.name: customer_name
columns.description: Full customer name — not unique, so never a key

columns.name: email
columns.description: Customer email address

rationale.purpose: Central customer reference shared across domains
rationale.design: Conformed dimension for consistent customer attributes
rationale.scdStrategy: customer_key is the surrogate facts join to; customer_id is the source system's business key

models.name: dim_date
models.description: Date dimension with fiscal calendar attributes

columns.name: date_key
columns.description: Date key in YYYYMMDD form — meaningful by convention, unlike every other surrogate

columns.name: calendar_date
columns.description: The calendar date — the business key this dimension is identified by

columns.name: fiscal_year
columns.description: Fiscal year number

columns.name: fiscal_quarter
columns.description: Fiscal quarter (Q1-Q4)

rationale.purpose: Shared date reference for consistent time-based analysis
rationale.design: The one dimension where a meaningful key is conventional — date_key is YYYYMMDD rather than a meaningless sequence

columns.name: order_id
columns.description: Order id from the source system — a degenerate dimension, and this fact's own key

columns.name: customer_key
columns.description: FK to dim_customer

columns.name: order_date
columns.description: Date the order was placed

columns.name: project_key
columns.description: FK to dim_project

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Order total amount
